entities.summary: Aoi Itō  is a Japanese tennis player. She has a career-high singles ranking of No. 82, by the WTA, achieved on 18 August 2025, and also has a career-high doubles ranking of world No. 180, achieved on 16 September 2024. Ito has won one WTA 125 singles title.
